title: Correct U_AB calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly computes U_AB = W_AB / q, yielding +5 V.

title: Correct U_BC sign
description: Important: Student correctly identifies that work done by the electrostatic force from B to C gives U_BC = W_BC / q = -2 V.

title: Potential at C
description: Essential: Student uses φ_B = 0 and U_BC = φ_B - φ_C to find φ_C = 2 V.

title: Work from A to C
description: Important: Student correctly sums the works (W_AC = W_AB + W_BC) to find total work by field as -1.8e-5 J.

title: Potential energy change
description: Essential: Student states ΔU = -W_field for A→C, giving +1.8e-5 J increase.

title: Sign confusion in U_AB
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses work 'overcoming the force' as positive for U_AB formula, leading to wrong sign.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis (J/C = V) for potential differences.

title: Direction of energy change
description: Important: Student explicitly states whether potential energy increases or decreases for A→C.
